232K likes, 797 comments - garyvee on October 18, 2026: "Their smiling isn’t leading to your frowning …. 

We need to clean up our “cars” 🚗 to enjoy what others are enjoying 

The world has abundance - there is plenty of happiness, joy, richness to  go around but it’s on you to have the perspective and then the discipline and actions to “get there” 

You’re capable … you are … and once you know this … it unlocks".
